# Math Blocks and Inline Math

## Inline math

The mass-energy equivalence is $E = mc^2$.

Pythagoras: $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$.

Quadratic formula: $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$.

## Block math

$$
\int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-x^2} \, dx = \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}
$$

## Matrix notation

$$
\begin{pmatrix}
a & b \\
c & d
\end{pmatrix}
\begin{pmatrix}
x \\
y
\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}
ax + by \\
cx + dy
\end{pmatrix}
$$

## Summation and product

$$
\sum_{i=1}^{n} i = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
$$

$$
\prod_{i=1}^{n} i = n!
$$

## Greek letters and symbols

- $\alpha, \beta, \gamma, \delta, \epsilon$
- $\Gamma, \Delta, \Theta, \Lambda, \Xi, \Pi, \Sigma, \Phi, \Psi, \Omega$
- $\forall x \in \mathbb{R}, \exists y \in \mathbb{N}$

## Limits and derivatives

$$
\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{1}{x} = 0
$$

$$
\frac{d}{dx} \left( x^2 \right) = 2x
$$

## Math inside list

- First item with $a + b = c$
- Second item with $\frac{1}{2}$
  - Nested with $\sqrt{x}$
  - Nested with $x^2$

## Math inside table

| Formula | Result |
| --- | --- |
| $1 + 1$ | $2$ |
| $2^3$ | $8$ |
| $\sqrt{16}$ | $4$ |
| $\log_{10} 100$ | $2$ |

## Math inside blockquote

> The famous identity: $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$

## Case notation

$$
f(x) = \begin{cases}
  x^2 & \text{if } x \geq 0 \\
  -x^2 & \text{if } x < 0
\end{cases}
$$
